name: WHSKD
address: 15131 NW 67th Ave, Miami Lakes, FL 33014, United States

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Angelica Gonzalez
reviewSamples.text: Whskd is easily the best matcha and coffee that Miami Lakes has ! The Matcha and Coffee are both amazing, and the owners are incredibly sweet and welcoming. I love that they always have fun new monthly flavors to try. Definitely worth trying !

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Faith Sola-Collado
reviewSamples.text:
Soooo yummy!
I got the banana bread matcha with oat milk, cream on top, and cinnamon and salt. I also got a cookie. I do think that they are expensive and more of a treat than an every day thing. Total for the drink and cookie was $18
